notes:
Cut Valet 1.3.0 — the big one. Highlights:

- One window: Library, Edit, Deliver, Archive and Settings tabs on one bar; over 170 pop-up dialogs became in-window sheets and notices; Settings is one searchable rail; tools open in the working pane.
- Queue tray: Queue, Activity, Chat and Suggestions in one column; lane verbs (skip, pause, send to back); "Hand it to Resolve" stops everything in under a second; Wait for off hours.
- Ingest: a five-stop dial (Auto, Copy only, Words, Words + vision, Every signal) shared by cards, drops, watch folders and the archive; the Media well fills as the copy runs; the day copied in shot order; production sound as its own lane.
- Drop import can leave files where they are, match a drop to a camera on record, and handle several cameras in one drop.
- Multicam: clips on a common clock or matched by sound become a take; Sync by sound (was Match audio) shows the alignment on waveform lanes; Find by sound matches takes of one song by waveform alone; takes can be ungrouped and undone.
- Frame ledger: one decode per clip; ten log profiles corrected from the vendors' own maths (S-Log, C-Log, N-Log, V-Log, F-Log, D-Log, Protune, LogC).
- People is a tool: faces ride the describe pass, readable previews, reversible merges, names reach search and sidecars.
- Brain and providers: one app-wide brain pill; Fable 5.1 and Opus 5; OpenRouter; Accounts cards with spend and a monthly cap; first-class Ollama with a local default set.
- Chat tab is a real assistant: same tool loop as MCP, per-project threads, streaming with Stop, voice input.
- Timelines are documents first (.otio), sent to Resolve as one batch; strip filmstrips, waveforms and keyboard zoom; AI Cut Planner with honest auto-cut; MCP document, bin and ingest tools.
- Deliver is a to-do list with editable export presets, Resolve's timeline picker, and Thumbnail Lab rebuilt.
- Archive: one search over everything ever shot, rescan follows moved files, indexing speed dial.
- Reliability: Whisper on Apple GPUs in a child process (no more CPU pin), dead-GPU stand-down, OCR at the gate, Qwen partial coverage is not success, AppleDouble forks are not clips, quit waits for the queues, sidecars v3.
- Setup wizard is one question per step with a receipt; twelve-card first-run tour; update screen on arrival; Marketplace with install and uninstall.

Full detail in CHANGELOG.md. Known limitations: D-Log M is approximated with plain D-Log; Social Distribute is not ready (Soon badge); 120 fps projects play back at 24 in Resolve's Edit page.
